title: A tool returned needing repair is back in lending once marked repaired
steps: Registers a member, adds a tool and has the member borrow it.
The librarian returns the loan with the condition needing repair and a note.
Opens the catalog: the tool needs repair, with the return note as its damage note, and borrowing it is refused.
The librarian marks the tool repaired and opens the catalog again.
expected_result: The tool is in good condition, its damage note cleared, and the member can borrow it again.

title: A member borrows a tool and returns it on time, and the next member can borrow it
steps: Registers two members and adds a tool.
The first member borrows the tool and is told its due date.
The librarian returns the loan in good condition on its due date.
The second member borrows the tool.
expected_result: The return is not late, and the tool is lent to the second member.

title: A newly registered member opens their first loan
steps: The librarian registers a new member and is shown their member ID.
The new member borrows the tool with that ID.
expected_result: The new member has one open loan, with its due date.
